title: filo trace, format v1
description: One traced request, CLI run, test or capture, as written to <project>/.filo/traces and served by the viewer API. Within v1, new optional properties may be added: consumers must ignore properties they don't know.

ts.description: When the trace was written, ISO 8601 (PHP date('c')).

duration.description: Wall time in nanoseconds, breakpoint pauses and filo's own instrumentation excluded.

capped.description: True when filo stopped recording part-way (event budget or memory_limit), so the events are incomplete.

context.description: Where the trace came from. Web requests set method and uri, CLI runs argv, per-test artifacts test and status, Recorder captures capture.

status.description: Why a per-test artifact was written.

events.description: One per instrumented call, in call order.

name.description: Added by the viewer API (GET /api/traces), never stored: the file name under .filo/traces, e.g. "tests/App_FooTest__testBar.json".

i.description: Event id, unique within the trace.

p.description: Parent event id; -1 for a root.

fn.description: Function name: __METHOD__ for functions and methods ("App\\Repo::find"), {closure:<scope>:<line>} for closures.

s.description: Start, in ns from the start of the trace.

e.description: End, in ns from the start of the trace. Self time = (e - s) minus the children's (e - s).
